correctness.rationale: Proper color classes are confined to host parts. Two classes from distinct parts induce a complete bipartite graph, and a connected bipartite forbidden graph with shore sizes \(s\le t\) embeds exactly when those class sizes dominate \(s,t\) in one orientation. This makes the two-regime classification exhaustive; each regime has matching lower and upper constructions. The \(s=1\) boundary is explicit. The checker agrees with the formula in 1080 finite parameter cases, used only as a stress test.
